decisions.reason: As a training service that builds directly on existing capabilities and customer relationships, it is cheap to carry and supports the installed base, so its option value remains higher than its carrying cost.
This accessory is close to the core business and likely inexpensive to keep available, so management would usually retain it unless demand has clearly disappointed.

Because it is distant from the established offer and likely requires scarce development and support resources, the firm would be inclined to end it once several years have reduced uncertainty without clear evidence of strong traction.
Although a machine platform is costlier to maintain, this product is close to the firm's core technological and commercial strengths, making it a strategic option worth keeping in a growing market.
An automatic tool change system complements the firm's equipment portfolio and service model, and its strong fit with existing products makes continued market presence relatively attractive.
